name: tools-that-dont-upload-local
description: Offline tools for Claude: Korean text and business documents, PDF merge/split/rotate, hashing. Nothing is uploaded.
long_description: A local MCP server that runs entirely on your computer. It makes no network requests. Includes Korean tools (romanization, amounts in words, particles, initial consonants, business-number checksum, personal-data masking), Korean business documents (견적서, 거래명세서 as XLSX; 차용증, 표준근로계약서 as DOCX), PDF tools using local file paths (merge, extract pages, rotate, info), and utilities (hash, Base64, UUID, JSON format, text case, password generator). Output files are saved to ~/Downloads by default. Document templates are general forms, not legal advice.

tools.name: ko_romanize
tools.description: Romanize Korean text (Revised Romanization, syllable by syllable, as used for personal names).

tools.name: ko_amount_words
tools.description: Write an amount in Korean words, e.g. 1234000 -> 일금 일백이십삼만사천원정.

tools.name: ko_josa
tools.description: Attach the correct particle (은/는, 이/가, 을/를, 과/와, 으로/로 ...).

tools.name: ko_chosung
tools.description: Extract initial consonants (초성).

tools.name: kr_business_number
tools.description: Validate a Korean business registration number checksum (does not confirm registration).

tools.name: ko_pii_mask
tools.description: Mask resident registration numbers, phone numbers, emails and card numbers in text.

tools.name: text_case
tools.description: Convert case: upper, lower, title, sentence, camel, pascal, snake, kebab, constant, dot.

tools.name: password_gen
tools.description: Generate random passwords locally.

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Hash text or a local file with sha256 (default), sha1, sha512 or md5.

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Encode or decode Base64 (UTF-8).

tools.name: uuid
tools.description: Generate random UUID v4 values.

tools.name: json_format
tools.description: Pretty-print or minify JSON and report syntax errors.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge local PDF files into one. Files never leave this computer.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Page count and metadata of a local PDF.

tools.name: pdf_extract_pages
tools.description: Save selected pages of a local PDF as a new PDF (e.g. "1-3,5").

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Rotate all pages of a local PDF by 90/180/270 degrees.

tools.name: kr_quote
tools.description: Create a Korean quotation (견적서) with VAT and amount in words.

tools.name: kr_transaction_statement
tools.description: Create a Korean transaction statement (거래명세서).

tools.name: kr_loan_agreement
tools.description: Create a Korean IOU / loan agreement (차용증). General template, not legal advice.

tools.name: kr_employment_contract
tools.description: Create a Korean standard employment contract (표준근로계약서). General template, not legal advice.
